record.body: Downstream dspygen qualification exposed a repeated-interpretation defect: CI maintained an explicit list of generated Python outputs and required a consumer-local repair when a third projection appeared. R82 returns this once upstream as a source-derived GeneratedArtifact closure with validator contracts. No unchanged retry; exact dspygen head then qualified successfully and was assimilated to default lineage.
